featured_reviews.name: Mansha Pais
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been ordering meals from this place every day for the past month and it has been a consistently good experience. The portions are generous and they offer a nice variety like pav bhaji and puri bhaji on some days, to break the usual rice-and-dal routine. They even surprise you with a sweet dish occasionally. While the dry sabzi and gravy can be mildly spicy for some, the dal is exceptional and more than makes up for it. Delivery times can vary, but that is understandable given Santacruz East traffic. Overall, the food feels homely and I am more than happy to keep ordering from them.

featured_reviews.name: Nishank Anand
featured_reviews.review_text:
I started this tiffin services yummy tiffins was in touch with Vivek here  as i was wanting to eat home cooked like meals

There were issues with this tiffin services pertaining to
1. delivery each time they damaged the plastic containers while doing their deliveries -i kept informing Vivek-what I did not like is they should take complete ownership of delivries and not be vague or clueless abt their delivery people Vivek sent me some 2 people's nos who one would deliver for lunch the other for dinner after which I get a call from someone else saying he would deliver this happened twice in 2days which was informed on whats app to Vivek i must have ordered customised 8-10meals  which they charge extra delivery charges which i did not like their boxes packing was damaged -this was also informed to Vivek but it did not improve

2.Food was not very good in taste being from a punjabi north indian family i could say it in 2 meals itself but I wanted to try and see other options which I did but it was not upto the mark for the price they charge including delivery charges

3.Though they have teams but hands on control was wanted as vivek seemed lost (co owner) whenever I raised the issue the concept of we will make it right or refund did not seem existing there the typical answer from vivek was i will inform my team etc...than feeling apologetic about it felt like some charitable service was given which was free of cost -the attitude of professionalism seemed missing only packing food instead papercartrons mentioning indias best tiffin services does not make them the best they need to feel concerned immidiate action is solicited which was absent .

4.overall sometimes the kadi sent was absolutely bland food was stinking on 2-3occasions which had to be thrown away on other occasions rajma was half cooked some vegetables were unrecognisable and for paneer sabzi they do a blanatant mockery only 3small pcs in a 250ml container ???

Overall my verdict if the whole world has closed its door and ure in dire circumstances only then this may be the last option then eat the price they charge and vis a vis food given  (i took customised option) did not meet my expectations my servants back home eat much better than this food hate saying it but its true

Food -1/5
Quantity-2/5
Service-1/5

The only thing appreciated is their online ordering where you could order as you wanted before 12noon for same day dinner

For lunch- Before 8pm for  next day lunch (this could be changed to 9am same day)

featured_reviews.review_text: The overall food quality was good. The dabeli had a nice tangy flavor, and the order was well prepared for 100 people.

featured_reviews.name: Prathamesh Bandekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been ordering from Yummy Tiffins on a daily basis, and it has been a great experience so far. The combination of  bhaji, rotis, salad, and dal/soup makes for a filling and well-balanced meal at a very reasonable price.

One of the best things about their service is the monthly menu planning you get the entire month’s menu in advance, which makes it super convenient. Even better, you can easily cancel tiffin for specific days directly on their website, without the hassle of calling or messaging.

The monthly subscription discount is another big plus, making it even more value-for-money. Also, the variety in cuisines like kofta, thecha, noodles, pasta, soup keeps things interesting, I never really got bored of the food.

featured_reviews.review_text: They offer a variety of different packages, the package I chose is the Jumbo Meal. It has dal, rice, 1 dry sabzi, 1 gravy sabzi and salad or soup. The food is very tasty, healthy and tastes just like home cooked meals. I have been a customer of Yummy Tiffin for a few years now and I am very pleased with the quality, taste and service. It’s value for money.

featured_reviews.name: Avantika Meghan Kamat
featured_reviews.review_text: The service is amazing in addition to the food quality and quantity being really good. The kitchen is also super clean and hygienic. The ability to choose what you want in your meals allows you to eat what you wish which is something great. Overall if you're in Mumbai I feel this is a must try for your meals.

featured_reviews.name: A
featured_reviews.review_text: I ordered for the first time from here. What I liked about this service provider is that we can choose the dishes from their daily menu, this I think is a brilliant way to reduce food wastage. We had ordered Rajma, Chapati, Chole Rice bowl and Dal Khichdi bowl. The only item I liked was Rajma. Chapati was alright, but chole rice bowl lacked gravy and was spicy. The dal khichdi was tasteless but was cooked well. The rice in the chole bowl was cooked well too. The good part was the food wasn't oily, but the taste can be definitely improved. Food arrived on time and was packed well. Ordering the food from the website was hassle-free.

Founder is such a humble human, really loved the way he spoke with me.

Welfare of Dabbawalas
Medi Claim Policy
Dabbawalas have to work hard to ensure that the right tiffin box reach the right customer at right time. This job involves working in all weather conditions like high rain, cold and extreme summer. Due to this, the chance of falling sick increases tremendously. In case of high medical and hospitalization bill, the financial condition of Dabbawala is severely affected.

In order to sort out this problem, Dabbawala Enterprises Private Limited offers Rs. 100,000 (1 Lakhs) medi claim policy to Dabbawalas covering their entire family. This ensures that in the unfortunate event of falling sick or hospitalization, the Dabbawalas are financially secured.

Welfare of Dabbawalas
Insurance
The job of collecting and delivering Tiffin Boxes is a highly risky endeavor undertaken by Dabbawala. Every year thousands of people die on the tracks of Mumbai local trains. In the unfortunate incident of accident of Dabbawala, their families have to undergo an extreme financial hardship which devastates them financially.

In order to sort out this problem, Dabbawala Enterprises Private Limited offers RS. 10,00,000 (10 Lakhs) insurance policy to Dabbawalas. This ensures that in the unfortunate event of an accident, the families of Dabbawalas are financially secured.
